description.value:
You've created an adaptable coating that can neutralize a variety of energies. You gain the following new mod.

  • Energy Neutralizer (armor): Select an energy type when you apply this mod: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The item and the item's wearer gain resistance equal to your Intelligence modifier against the selected energy type. At 10th level, you can select two energy types, and at 15th level, you can select three energy types.
